name: NY-20
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Paul Tonko seeking re-election in a D+8 district
Huge financial advantage: Tonko has raised $958k vs. $29k for Ambrosio
Prediction markets price Tonko at 96% to win
No public polling or expert ratings, so fundamentals carry the forecast
model.rationale: Tonko combines incumbency, a Democratic-leaning district, and a roughly 33-to-1 fundraising edge, while markets price his re-election at 96 percent. With no polls or ratings to contradict the fundamentals, the race stays firmly in Safe D territory.
model.watch: A late surge of outside spending against Tonko or unexpectedly strong Republican fundraising would be the first sign the race deserves a second look.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Paul Tonko, a Democratic incumbent, is seeking another term in a district that leans Democratic by about eight points on the partisan baseline. His Republican challenger, Ralph Ambrosio, has run a minimal campaign, reporting under $30,000 raised and barely $8,000 on hand, while Tonko holds over $400,000 in cash. No outside groups are active against the incumbent.

Prediction markets give Tonko roughly a 96 percent chance of winning, and the fundamentals point the same way: district lean, incumbency, and a large money advantage all favor the Democrat. With no public polling available, the forecast rests on those structural factors, which consistently point to a comfortable Tonko re-election.
